execute: Locate the actor-action-object rule and its source. Establish the owner's successful operation and the requesting actor's own valid baseline. Compare the same operation with one relevant identity or object change, preserving method, body, media type, deployment and session conditions. Retrieve raw responses and independent business readback where needed. Record unknown sharing rules, expired sessions or missing baselines as gaps. Returned job/file IDs are products, not changed input variables. Status, body length or a nonempty credential alone cannot establish request validity or access.
review: Support only a restricted business result obtained against the applicable rule with valid controls. A valid baseline plus business denial and no restricted result refutes this tested actor/action/object claim. Missing policy, baseline or readback stays unknown. Reopen for changed identity, sharing, request validity or deployment; other operations remain untested.
